what_it_is.prose: Pixxel is a Bengaluru-based spacetech startup building the world's highest-resolution commercial hyperspectral Earth-imaging constellation. Founded in 2019 at BITS Pilani by Awais Ahmed (CEO) and Kshitij Khandelwal (CTO). The Firefly constellation (6 satellites, all launched 2025) provides 5 m spatial resolution with 150+ spectral bands — capturing up to 50× more data than conventional multispectral satellites. Pixxel is the first Indian company to be selected for NASA's $476M Commercial SmallSat Data Acquisition (CSDA) Program On-Ramp1 Multiple Award Contract (Sep 2024), enabling supply of hyperspectral EO data to NASA and US Government/academic partners through November 2028. Phase-1 of Firefly completed 26 Aug 2025 with the launch of 3 additional satellites aboard SpaceX Falcon 9 NAOS mission. Next-generation Honeybee constellation scheduled for 2026. Total funding $60M+ (Series B led by Google Jun 2023 + $24M extension Dec 2024).
